observer: Codex visual inspection through CUA of the live native review app; not a record of user approval.

presentation.mode: Live PetRenderView embedded in an AppKit review window for single-window capture.

observations.subject: Native scale and readability
observations.detail: CUA showed the live 224-point character on both backgrounds. The leaf silhouette, warm ivory face, dark eyes, cheeks and tucked paws remain readable at desktop size.

observations.subject: Transparent edges
observations.detail: No opaque rectangle or light fringe was visible around the native light/dark presentations. The independent 244-frame perimeter-alpha check separately passed.

observations.subject: Contact shadow
observations.detail: The shadow is localized and soft at 224 points on both backgrounds. Raw-alpha grain is visible in enlarged 448-pixel review frames; native-size inspection did not make further rendering necessary.

observations.subject: Motion and expression assets
observations.detail: Idle, directional walking poses, the closed-eye pet response and neutral endpoints were visually inspected from actual rendered frames. Both 5.633-second comparison movies encode all 169 authored frames, using the runtime root offsets.

observations.subject: Live finite playback
observations.detail: The embedded native run traversed idle, the selected walk, pet and settle on each background and passed 14 checks. Replay controls were exercised. Separate real-panel lifecycle validation passed 22 checks, including compensated placement and request-boundary continuity.

limitations: CUA captures the board window independently of its separate floating panel. The appearance evidence therefore uses the live native renderer embedded at the same 224-point size; it is not a screenshot of cross-window compositing.
Separate native lifecycle evidence measures actual panel origin plus actual image-layer offset. These geometry checks do not prove atomic physical WindowServer/GPU presentation.
Offline comparison movies may be scaled by a viewer. Their JSON records source and intended display sizes.
Physical cross-app input, Spaces, display changes, system sleep/wake and battery behavior remain broader acceptance work.
